hero_description: Discover new words with Wordistan, create your personal dictionaries, and experience lasting learning with effective games.
mkt_subtitle: With Wordistan's practical features, don't just memorize words; master them with fun and reinforcement.
mkt_dict_desc: Build unlimited dictionaries tailored to your interests and level, organize words, share with friends, and access anytime.
mkt_games_desc: Play word games with your custom dictionaries to reinforce what you've learned and make learning fun.
mkt_translate_desc: Quickly look up words and short phrases, understand their meanings with context, and add them directly to your dictionary.
mkt_collections_desc: Access carefully curated vocabulary collections across diverse themes and levels to start learning immediately.
mkt_offline_desc: Access your vocabulary lists and games anywhere, anytime, even without an active internet connection.
about_hero_title_1: Turn Language Learning Into a Habit,
about_hero_desc: Wordistan is a next-generation language platform where you can build personal dictionaries, reinforce words through interactive games, and track your progress step by step.
about_sec_intro_desc: Wordistan transforms vocabulary learning from a boring memorization chore into an empowering personalized journey. Translate and save words on the fly, set goals, and manage your level from your profile.
about_sec_intro_item_1: All-in-one vocabulary learning and translation assistant
about_sec_intro_item_2: Instant and intuitive word & phrase translation tools
about_sec_intro_item_3: Comprehensive user profile and level management
about_sec_intro_item_4: Consistent learning habits supported by daily goals
about_sec_dicts_desc: Build unlimited dictionaries customized to your interests, career, or exam targets. Organize your words effortlessly and share collections with friends in a single tap.
about_sec_dicts_item_2: Save words and definitions in one tap
about_sec_dicts_item_3: Export and share dictionaries with peers
about_sec_dicts_item_4: Full offline access without an active internet connection
about_sec_games_desc: Test your vocabulary with diverse game modes designed to stimulate memory and make practice addictive. Each game is tailored to solidify words into long-term recall.
about_sec_games_item_1: Word completion with interactive letter blocks
about_sec_games_item_4: Instantly generate games from your custom dictionaries
about_sec_stats_desc: Track your game sessions, accuracy percentages, and learning pace with rich data visualizations. Spot your strongest areas and see what needs review.
about_sec_stats_item_1: Session history and in-depth performance analytics
about_sec_stats_item_2: Accuracy rates and question distribution charts
about_sec_stats_item_3: Daily streak and study consistency monitoring
about_sec_stats_item_4: Visual learning curve and XP progression metrics
about_sec_pref_desc: Switch between sleek dark and light themes, configure your interface language, and customize game duration and question counts to match your study rhythm.
about_sec_pref_item_1: Elegant Light and Dark theme support
about_sec_pref_item_2: Bilingual interface in Turkish and English
about_sec_pref_item_3: Customizable question count, timer, and modes
about_sec_pref_item_4: Default launch screen and notification preferences
about_sec_achieve_desc: Level up, earn XP, and unlock achievement badges. Celebrate learning milestones and turn daily vocabulary building into an exciting adventure.
about_sec_achieve_item_1: Dynamic Leveling and XP reward system
about_sec_achieve_item_3: Animated reward celebrations on every milestone
about_cta_desc: Discover Wordistan for free; start building custom dictionaries and master words through fun exercises right now.
footer_slogan: Build your dictionaries, play word games, master vocabulary.
